sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

         But the racing itself is just the beginning - Squid Race also features a variety of mini-games and challenges that players must complete to progress through the game. Every challenge you overcome will earn you rewards and help you level up, unlocking new characters, items, and features that will aid you in your quest for victory.
